title: Figure 5.9: Axial magnetic field strength along two-unit MCSA centerline
description: Line plot captioned 'Figure 5.9. Axial Magnetic Field Strength Along Two-Unit MCSA Centerline', with 'Centerline Magnetic Field Strength' (-20 to 120) on the y-axis versus 'Axial Position (m)' (-1 to 1) on the x-axis. Annotations mark two 'Low-Field Confinement Regions' (dips to zero) and a central 'High-Field Magnetic Channel Region'. It accompanies a section titled 'Retrapping of Axial-Loss Particles' on KAM scattering.
